_doc: Bus types as the seznam-autobusu.cz register names them (maker + type) -> nominal length in metres (blank where the register gives none and the type name does not say); 'garages': the register's garage codes (DPP and the other operators; Stenbus's 'PID' is its PID division, not a garage, so blank). Pak objects are not mapped here: 04_courses.py names each car's object from pak_requested.json and checks it against pak_objects.json (no stand-ins from DPP or other cities). Suburban types the PID regional companions use, added 30 Oct 2026 (Setra S 415 LE business and S 515 LE, Citaro C2 GÜ, Iveco Crossway LE LINE 12M, SOR ICN 10,5; manufacturer lengths, rounded). Only those: a length makes a type eligible as a designed fleet bus, and other types would change existing cards' picks (226).
